Atcon Global - Senior Data Engineer (Microsoft BI & Azure Databricks) H/F/X
Référence 5899435
|
Créé le 14 juillet 2026
Retour à la liste
Temps de travail :
Temps plein
Type de contrat :
Independant
Famille de métiers :
Informatique / Services informatiques
Description de l'entreprise
ATCON is a Belgium-based IT consulting firm established with a vision to empower businesses using the latest technologies and provide best-in-class services to our clients.
We support as an end-to-end IT solutions partner for digitalizing business processes and making the data meaningful.
Our approach is more solution-driven than technology one, focused to solve business challenges and deliver results. We do what is right for our clients and charge based on what we deliver not on billing hours.
Our team consists of self-motivated consultants with an agile mindset, global work exposure, and commitment to deliver the best services.
Description de la fonction
About the role
We're looking for an experienced Data Engineer to join a multidisciplinary Agile team within the Belgian healthcare sector.
In this role, you'll contribute to the development and maintenance of analytical data solutions that support healthcare policy, medical control and data-driven decision-making. You'll work closely with Technical Leads, Data Architects, Functional Analysts and Project Managers to design, build and maintain scalable data warehouses, data marts and reporting solutions using the Microsoft BI stack while supporting the organization's transition towards Azure Databricks.
Beyond strong technical expertise, we're looking for someone with a proactive mindset who enjoys collaborating with both technical and business stakeholders and takes ownership of delivering reliable, high-quality data solutions.
Responsibilities
Design, develop and maintain enterprise BI solutions, including data ingestion processes, data warehouses and data marts
Build scalable data integration solutions using the Microsoft BI stack and Azure Databricks
Develop and maintain ETL processes following established development standards and functional requirements
Design Data Warehouse solutions based on Kimball dimensional modelling principles
Develop reporting solutions using Power BI and SSRS
Test, troubleshoot and maintain analytical solutions while ensuring high standards of quality and performance
Produce clear technical documentation throughout the project lifecycle
Conduct prototype reviews, demonstrations and user training on developed data models
Collaborate closely with Technical Leads, Data Architects, Functional Analysts and Project Managers to deliver solutions in an Agile environment
Support the organization's transition towards Azure Databricks and modern cloud-based data engineering practices
Must-have requirements
Master's degree in Computer Science or equivalent through experience
Minimum 7 years of experience as a Data Engineer
Strong experience with the Microsoft BI stack, including Visual Studio, SSIS, SSAS, SSMS, SSRS, Power BI and SQL Server
Strong experience designing and developing data warehouses and data marts
Experience with Kimball dimensional modelling
Strong SQL Server development experience
Experience working in Agile environments
Fluent in Dutch or French with a passive knowledge of the second national language
Nice to have:
Azure Databricks
Python
Experience supporting cloud data platform migrations
Experience working in enterprise or public sector environments
What we're looking for
We're looking for a Data Engineer with strong technical skills, excellent data literacy and a pragmatic, solution-oriented mindset. You take ownership of your work, enjoy collaborating within multidisciplinary Agile teams and are motivated to build reliable, scalable analytical solutions that deliver real business value.
You communicate effectively, enjoy learning new technologies and contribute positively to a collaborative team environment.
Technical stack
Microsoft BI Stack (SSIS, SSAS, SSMS, SSRS)
SQL Server
Power BI
Azure Databricks
Python
Kimball Dimensional Modelling
